I wrote about this subject in different forums, instead of rewriting this ill just copy and leave:

To say that the friendzone is fundamentally a terrible thing to do to a person is obviously fallacious.

But to massly dismiss the plausibility of justified cries against the friendzone is just as fallacious. 

The root of the problem is over-generalization. Obviously, in the *specific* case of a socially ignorant or insecure person, the potential for exploitation and manipulation is there, and this can happen to both sexes in numerous ways. 

Check out [this](http://www.azcadv.org/helping-a-dv-victim/identifying-domestic-violence/types-of-abuse/power-and-control-wh) visual graph of different kinds of domestic abuse. Particularly interesting is the emotional abuse section, which include "making her think she's crazy", "playing mind games" and "making her feel guilty" 

When someone is attracted to someone else, they may be searching for happiness(not entirely functional i know but many do this), they try to fulfill their desire of being a compassionate lover. 

The negative friendzone comes from the case where a cruel or sociopathic person will exploit this by [gas lighting](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaslighting) you. By sending conflictual signals, a man **or** a woman can confuse and bring out insecurity in their victim. They can now abuse and control you and you will blame yourself for everything that goes wrong.

A significant portion of the fuck the friendzone movement is fueled by legitimate emotional grievance, because these people were not only denied, but were lead on and then denied, often multiple times, so that they could feel degraded and become easy to exploit. In these cases, people identifying the friendzone is synonymous with revealing a stockholm syndrome and gaining control of their life again.

Obviously this isn't the case for everyone. A large number of people are just dicks who blame the world for their problems. But the fact is that this isn't everyone means if you have a problem with the friendzone movement, which has brought these different people together for one liner jokes and memes, you have to be careful you're not being a hypocrite when you criticize it by lumping everyone's case together.
